lnds_menu.description: Instrumental main-menu loop: verse 2 + chorus B of the approved song, vocals removed (bars 25-40, 16 bars)

lnds_rumble.description: City Rumble in-match mix: chorus A + chorus B, instrumental, drums/bass forward, mid pocket for SFX (16 bars)

lnds_suddendeath.description: Sudden Death version: same 16-bar grid as the rumble mix (position-synced crossfade), drums +1.7 dB, brighter, heartbeat toms, hats, snare rolls, risers

lnds_boss_1.description: Boss theme level 1/3 (stalking): the song's bass and 'other' stems transposed -5 semitones (F->C) over its own drums; levels share one 16-bar grid

lnds_boss_2.description: Boss theme level 2/3 (engaged): the song's bass and 'other' stems transposed -5 semitones (F->C) over its own drums; levels share one 16-bar grid

lnds_boss_3.description: Boss theme level 3/3 (all-out): the song's bass and 'other' stems transposed -5 semitones (F->C) over its own drums; levels share one 16-bar grid

lnds_sting.description: WAHALA! logo sting: a riser into the chorus's first sung line (the original recording, bars 9-10) with an impact
lnds_sting.gameEvent: title / logo reveal (no game hook yet)

lnds_victory.description: Victory cue: the approved song's own outro and ending (bars 42-45), with a low impact on the downbeat
lnds_victory.source: original mix from 89.5 s to the end

lnds_defeat.description: Defeat cue: one bar of the song's groove that slows like a tape stopping, with a low thud (comic, not cruel)

lnds_camp_calm.description: Campaign calm / briefing bed: the song's intro pad + bass, no drums, no vocals (bars 1-6)
lnds_camp_calm.gameEvent: campaign briefing, story cards, safe areas

lnds_camp_tension.description: Campaign tension bed: verse 1's 'other' stem (-5 st, low-passed) with a slow heartbeat (8 bars)

lnds_camp_alert.description: Campaign alert / pursuit bed: the song's hats and snares over its bass at -5 st, risers every 4 bars (8 bars)
lnds_camp_alert.gameEvent: campaign alert, enemy reinforcements, boss approach
lnds_camp_alert.source: bars 24-31 of drums (>1.5 kHz) + bass -5 st
